verdict.rationale: DBOS queues let you enqueue and run many workflows concurrently with managed flow control (dbos-docs-6), and a community user reports running workflows with tens of thousands of steps in production (dbos-comm-9), suggesting the library can support large-scale/bulk processing of items. However, there is no explicit 'bulk operation' API (e.g., batch enqueue, bulk retry/cancel across items) — it's inferred from general queue/concurrency primitives rather than a dedicated bulk-operations feature. missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch API for operating on many items in one call, first-party benchmarks or examples of large-scale bulk processing, and independent verification beyond a single anecdotal report.
